description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2154/16 of 18.12.2019, Rathmalana D/S Division
reasoning: This gazette exclusively concerns a land title amendment, specifically correcting the registered extent (area) of a defined parcel of land.
